gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Noto Sans Duployan reads wide and friendly, its a and e wide open. Under Vast Shadow's vintage, uniform-width capitals, a long stretch of it would feel relaxed and easy to follow, never crowded.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan brings large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut. And beside Vast Shadow's tall, bold lettering, a long stretch of it would read smoothly, without a single cramped corner.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads open and modern, with apertures that stay wide and ascenders hugging the x-height. Vast Shadow, bent like tubing, sits above it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Retro flash meets sturdy text. Vast Shadow keeps its thickness constant around every curve, while Noto Sans Ethiopic does its best work in tall, firm lowercase with c terminals hanging far from the bowl.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian has open curves throughout and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies, so it feels light and modern. Vast Shadow's chunky joins make the headline loud while this sans-serif simply carries on.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Noto Sans Glagolitic reads friendly, with round letters that stay clear at small sizes and a sturdy lowercase body. Yet over many lines it keeps its approachable manner, a quiet foil to Vast Shadow's lockstep curves and stems.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Vintage poster energy, then glass-bead lowercase. Vast Shadow shouts in its unmodulated strokes, and Noto Sans Gothic answers with big, parenthesis-round counters that let the eye rest right below.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha reads smooth, its flattened, tall little letters never snagging. Vast Shadow's ring-like o with a constant wall is what makes the pair memorable: loud outline above, quiet sans-serif below.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Crisp and modern, Noto Sans Gujarati ends its curves before they turn inward. Over a long passage it would feel open and unhurried, a calm partner to Vast Shadow's laser-cut look.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gon: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has lowercase strokes as tall as a crayon mark. Its strongest quality beside Vast Shadow is the plain sans openness of cut-back terminals against that cable-bent heading.
